data.name: Logix 256 KB 32-bit DRAM module

introduced.event_name: Shared module specification migration; original availability retained

specification.bank_organization: Two independently selected 32-bit modules share a 32-bit data bus; address decoding selects one module and rank. The pair is a capacity bank, not concatenated data lanes.
specification.installation: Matched pairs, power off. Controller must decode all modules and ranks and refresh all arrays.
specification.electrical_interface: Shared Artemis/Athena interface design target. Connector, rank selection, power, timing and loading qualification pending on each controller.

data.product_status: Accepted story design revision; physical implementation and electrical qualification pending.
manufacturing_requirements: 32 ×1 DRAM chips per rank. Independently selected full-width modules; no 64-bit host bus implied.
Requalify PCB, connector, decoding, refresh, buffers and routing; prior 16-bit module costs are not current estimates.
